2xs.$description: 2px. Hairline gaps, e.g. between an icon and a badge.

sm.$description: 8px. Gap between related items: label and input, icon and text.

md.$description: 12px. Default gap inside a component or a form row.

lg.$description: 16px. Padding of cards and dialogs; gap between form fields.

xl.$description: 24px. Gap between sections inside a page.

2xl.$description: 32px. Page padding and gaps between major regions.
